final_message:
Configured an internal DNS hierarchy for all requested names, including MX records for `company.com` and `university.edu`. The 40 PCs use the resolver on **pc40**; existing addresses, routes and connections were preserved.

The artificial root runs on pc1; pc2–pc5 serve the top-level zones, and dedicated PCs serve the delegated domains. The configuration assumes an isolated, IPv4-only laboratory. Existing `kathara/base` images already include BIND, so no image changes were needed.

All startup scripts passed a shell syntax check. BIND’s validation tools were unavailable locally, and the DNS configuration has not been tested in a running laboratory.
